_comment: Config for the NGSP Automation solution. Read by create_solution.py.

publisher._comment: Lookup criteria to find the publisher this solution should belong to. The script searches by 'prefix'. 'expected_uniquename' and 'expected_friendlyname' are sanity checks -- warn if they don't match.

solution._comment: Solution properties. 'unique_name' is locked once created. 'friendly_name' and 'description' can be updated later without recreating the solution.
solution.description: Nestle Nigeria Supply Chain Project -- SAP-to-Dataverse automation. Contains tables and columns for LX02, LX09, LT23, MB51, MB5T extractions across Flowergate (1478), Agbara (4981), and Abaji (6797) plants.
